h1: The 5 Best Murphy Beds With Storage and Desks of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Murphy Beds With Desk: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five Murphy beds with fold-down desks and storage, compared on size, weight rating, shelving, charging and installation.
mainKeyword: best murphy bed with storage and desk
summary: The Merax Queen is the best overall pick, packing a lit fold-down desk, power outlet, shelves and drawers into one unit. The Softa Queen is the choice for the highest stated weight rating, and the KEIKI is the easiest to fold daily. The MERITLINE Full suits tight rooms, and the LUXOAK Full is the storage-only budget option.
intro: A Murphy bed with a desk sounds like two rooms in one, but the real question is what happens when the bed is down: a desk that folds out of the cabinet may only work with the bed up, and the reverse. Many buyers discover this only after assembly, so the desk's behavior is the first thing to understand.

We reviewed five beds from the listings and ranked them on whether a desk is included, storage layout, weight rating, power and charging, and ease of folding. These units are heavy and often need two people or a professional to install, so we noted installation expectations too.

products.name: Merax Queen Size Murphy Bed with Desk and Lights, Power Outlet, Open Storage Shelves and Drawers
products.verdict: The most complete bed-desk-storage combination in the group.
products.description:
A queen-size platform with a fold-down desk that has lights, a built-in power outlet, open storage shelves and drawers, in an antique white finish. It sits in the $500 and up bucket.

It wins because it covers every item on the shopping list: desk, lighting, power and storage. The Softa below counts a higher weight rating, but it lists a charging station rather than a lit desk with an outlet.

Buy it if you need a real workstation and a queen bed in a small room. Plan for professional installation, since it is large.
products.idealFor: Small apartments that need a bed, desk and storage in one wall.
products.skipIf: You cannot handle a large assembly.

products.name: Softa Queen Murphy Bed Cabinet with Storage Drawer, Charging Station, 1200 LBS Heavy Duty Wood Wall Bed with Fold-Down Desk
products.verdict: A fold-down desk, drawer and charging with a 1200 lb stated rating.
products.description:
A queen-size cabinet bed with a fold-down desk, storage drawer, charging station and a stated 1200 lb heavy duty rating. No box spring is needed. It sits in the $500 and up bucket.

It ranks just below the Merax because it lacks a lit desk and open shelving, though the stated weight rating is the highest here. The rating is useful if two adults use the bed regularly.

Choose it if load capacity is your top worry. Treat the 1200 lb figure as the seller's claim and check how it is defined.
products.idealFor: Couples who want a high stated weight rating.

products.name: KEIKI Queen Murphy Bed with Desk, Space-Saving Wall Bed Cabinet, Foldable Hidden Bed Frame with Gas Struts
products.verdict: Gas struts make daily folding noticeably lighter work.
products.description:
A queen-size wood cabinet bed with a fold-down desk and a gas strut fold mechanism, in the $500 and up bucket.

It ranks third because the listing says less about storage and charging than the picks above. Its edge is the gas strut system, which assists lifting and lowering the frame so it is less of a chore each day.

Best for someone who will fold the bed daily. If you want shelves and outlets, the Merax packs more in.
products.idealFor: Daily folders who want effortless lifting.
products.skipIf: You want built-in charging and shelving.

products.name: MERITLINE Full Murphy Bed with Desk and Storage Shelves, Wood Hideaway Murphy Wall Bed with Storage Bookcase
products.verdict: A full-size wood bed with desk and bookcase shelving.
products.description:
A full-size wood Murphy bed with a fold-down desk and bookcase-style open storage shelves. The price bucket is not confirmed in the data we reviewed.

It ranks fourth because the full size sleeps one person comfortably but gives less room than the queen picks. The bookcase shelves are a plus over the KEIKI, which says little about storage.

Choose it for a small bedroom or office where a queen would crowd the floor. Check the current price on the listing.
products.idealFor: Solo sleepers in a small combined room.
products.skipIf: Two adults will sleep in it.

products.name: LUXOAK Full Murphy Cabinet Bed with Storage and Charging Station
products.verdict: Storage and charging at a lower price, with no desk.
products.description:
A full-size cabinet bed with an integrated storage cabinet and a built-in charging station, in the $200-500 bucket. It has no fold-down desk.

It ranks last because it does not offer a desk, which is half of this guide's promise. It stays in as the lowest-cost route to a space-saving wall bed with practical storage.

A fit for buyers who already have a desk and want to save money. If you need a workspace, pick one of the desk models above.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers who do not need a desk.

whatMatters.detail: On most combo beds the desk folds down from the cabinet when the bed is closed. That means you cannot use it while the bed is down. It matters because you may need a place to work during the day. Read the listing for how the desk is used and what is locked in each position.

A stated rating is the load the frame is built for, often with a safety margin. A couple plus bedding can approach several hundred pounds. Compare the stated number to your combined weight and check if it covers the mattress.
A full bed is about 54 inches wide and a queen is about 60. The cabinet depth also differs, so measure ceiling height and open-bed projection. Look for exact dimensions in the listing.
Gas struts or springs balance the bed's weight so you can lift it. A weak mechanism makes daily use a chore. Look for the words gas struts or piston in the title.
These beds are heavy and often must be anchored to a wall. Many buyers hire help. Check the listing for assembly notes and anchor hardware.

faq.q: Can I use the desk while the bed is down?
faq.a: Usually not. The desk folds out when the bed is stored. Read each listing for how the desk behaves and plan to fold the bed up during work hours.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake?
faq.a: Ignoring room height and depth. Measure the ceiling and the floor space needed when the bed is open, not just the cabinet size.

faq.q: Is queen worth it over full?
faq.a: For couples yes. A solo sleeper in a small room can use a full, such as the MERITLINE, and save floor space.

faq.q: Do I need a professional to install it?
faq.a: Many buyers do, because the cabinets are heavy and should anchor to a wall. Check what hardware the listing includes.

faq.q: Do I need to buy a mattress?
faq.a: Some listings include one, while many do not. Check the mattress thickness limit before choosing one.

faq.q: How do I maintain the fold mechanism?
faq.a: Keep the struts clean, check fasteners periodically and avoid loading the desk beyond its stated limit.

finalTake: The Merax Queen is the best choice for most small spaces, giving you a lit desk, outlet, shelves and drawers. Pick the Softa for the highest stated weight rating, the KEIKI for effortless folding, and the MERITLINE for a compact room. The LUXOAK is only for buyers who skip the desk.
